title: Temporal MMS with space-exact fields (u and p): BDF1 (negative control) and BDF2, Newton per step and semi-implicit, constant and variable (cyclic) steps, planar and axisymmetric with swirl
physics: rho (du/dt + (u.grad)u) - div sigma_form = f, div u = 0 with u(t) in P2 and p(t) in P1 for every t (non-polynomial in t; non-Beltrami; axisymmetric with swirl, centrifugal and Coriolis terms non-zero): the error is purely temporal

mesh.construction: f1a_stokes_check.structured_mesh(8) on [0,1]^2 in (x, y) or (r, z) (the fixed F1a base mesh); one mesh for every level: the fields are space-exact

cyclic.construction: step sizes proportional to the pattern repeated N/5 times, scaled to sum to T

time_scheme.bdf: BDF of order k on the actual step sequence, omega_n = dt_n / dt_{n-1}: BDF1 (u^n - u^{n-1}) / dt_n; BDF2 [(1 + 2 w)/(1 + w) u^n - (1 + w) u^{n-1} + w^2/(1 + w) u^{n-2}] / dt_n (f3a_transient_check.bdf_coefficients); the momentum equation, the load f(t_n), Dirichlet data g(t_n) and traction data at t_n; p^n is the Lagrange multiplier of div u^n = 0 (no pressure time derivative, no pressure extrapolation)
time_scheme.starter: BDF2 starts with ONE BDF1 step of the same size from the initial state (fixed for the cross-code case X1; any starter with local error O(dt^2) passes the order items)
time_scheme.newton: Newton per step: the fully implicit BDF system (convection c(u^n; u^n, v)) solved by Newton to the fixed newton_rtol 1e-12 (dual norm, relative to the step's lifted residual)
time_scheme.semi: semi-implicit (linearly implicit): c(w; u^n, v) with the extrapolated advecting velocity w = u^{n-1} (BDF1) or w = (1 + omega_n) u^{n-1} - omega_n u^{n-2} (BDF2; f3a_transient_check.extrapolation_coefficients); one linear solve per step
time_scheme.convection: standard form c(w; u, v) = rho ((w. grad) u, v) (F2a; the skew form only if the F2a/F3a notes offer it: not proposed here)
time_scheme.initial_data: u_h(t_0) is DISCRETELY DIVERGENCE-FREE and takes the nodal Dirichlet data at t_0 (projection of the initial data); the L2 (Leray) projection is the reference choice, any projection that is discretely divergence-free and O(h^3)-accurate in L2 passes (mms_ns_transient_initial)
time_scheme.dirichlet_data: P2 Lagrange NODAL interpolation of the fixed callables at t_n (vertices and edge midpoints); at an axis node u_r = u_theta = 0 beats the data (F2a shared-node rule)
time_scheme.quadrature_requirement: As F2a: the convective trilinear form, the mass form and every load integral are integrated EXACTLY for the polynomial integrands of P2 on affine triangles (degree >= 5 planar, >= 6 axisymmetric); the r-weighted viscous form in axisymmetry by a rule of degree >= 6. The mass matrix is the CONSISTENT one. The space-exact temporal MMS, the energy identities and the cross-code values assume it.

boundaries.planar: Dirichlet on all four edges (exact data, zero net flux)
boundaries.axisymmetric: Dirichlet on r = 1, z = 0, z = 1; axis conditions u_r = u_theta = 0 on r = 0, u_z natural

parameters.pressure: constant-pressure nullspace (all-Dirichlet): errors mean-free (r-weighted means in axisymmetry)
